reason: Existing-client and profile-derived STEAM_DOT contracts need an explicit decision before product/fixture code.

execution_contract.source_boundaries: Copy whole resulting installer unchanged; do not execute only extracted helpers. Keep FEX/runtime/Proton helper bodies fixed. Record transport and final engine/service boundaries; use real candidate ZIP reader and filesystem operations.
execution_contract.containment: Reuse reviewed no-NIC disposable GENERIC_X64 namespace/PID1/pidfd-parent-death/subreaper/readonly native-root/private storage/proc/binfmt/null/route/socket guards. No host/device/owner client or account.
execution_contract.receipts: Record first installer/child/signal exits before assessing; original failed result immutable; deliberate retry separate. Outer PASS may mean expected refusal verified, never original install success.
execution_contract.preservation: Before/after paths, types, modes, dev/inode, lengths, full hashes, link targets; explicitly allowed owned additions separate. Atomic helper refreshes have their existing narrowly documented identity exceptions.
execution_contract.allocations: One fresh output per independent control. No hidden retry or suite allocation. Finite deadlines/log/artifact/free-space/hard capacity forecast must be reviewed for the resulting fixture.
execution_contract.readiness: Synthetic archive/ELF structure never establishes native launch, external loader resolution, self-update, signature trust, shipped-image dependency closure or power-loss safety.

cases.seed: Existing supported real Steam root with no client; separate SDK tree, game/save, runtime, FEX, Proton, channel/alias custom sentinels.
cases.injection: Synthetic ZIP follows all 55 observed member names/types, all five mappings and all three relative links, with self-created structurally valid nonbootable payloads. Only the final client execution is recorded at an explicit whole-caller execution boundary.
cases.required_observation: Original full caller 0 only after the candidate's complete validation/metadata commit; canonical complete tree; no literal-backslash siblings created; all unrelated/custom state unchanged. No native-readiness claim.
cases.boundary: No shell stub or truncated ELF may masquerade as a positive strict ELF validation input.

cases.seed: Same fresh client under existing Steam -> /storage/games-internal/roms/steam alias.
cases.injection: Normal caller; record logical and physical destination identities independently.
cases.required_observation: Alias inode/mode/target and unrelated tree remain identical; only the exact owned new client and permitted absent metadata added.
cases.boundary: Use the existing root-plan resolution, not host path.resolve on namespace-absolute links.

cases.seed: Allowed Steam alias on one synthetic filesystem, .steam on another, both supported and writable.
cases.injection: Normal caller.
cases.required_observation: Parent-local metadata publication succeeds without cross-filesystem rename assumptions; existing SDK files and alias targets preserved.
cases.boundary: Requires a separately admitted disposable mount fixture; not prepared or allocated here.

cases.seed: Complete candidate-owned synthetic bootstrap plus its verifiable inventory, extra custom file, nondefault beta and existing accepted .steam aliases.
cases.injection: No client network or decode supplied; other full-caller synthetic inputs remain available.
cases.required_observation: Read-only inventory revalidation passes; client/receipt/channel/aliases/custom/SDK identities and bytes unchanged; no client download or rewrite. Whole-caller later helper changes separately accounted.
cases.boundary: Receipt schema depends on the implementation decision; this is not the historical shell-sentinel valid-existing test.

cases.seed: Structurally complete-looking legacy synthetic client; no trustworthy current inventory; custom files and chosen channel retained.
cases.injection: Invoke whole script with recording profile sentinel.
cases.required_observation: A: refusal before profile, set_kill, transport, FEX/runtime/Proton and client execution; all before/after manifests identical. B: expected disposition remains undecided until exact structural predicate is defined.
cases.boundary: Never label the seeded legacy tree corrupt merely because it is unverified.

cases.seed: Start from complete verified synthetic client, then model a legitimate companion byte/version change while preserving old receipt.
cases.injection: No network or execution allowed to repair/reclassify.
cases.required_observation: A: truthful unverified-state refusal before any mutation; all current bytes retained. B: supported-layout predicate must explicitly cover/reject this state.
cases.boundary: Modeled self-update is not actual native self-update qualification.

cases.seed: Only steamrtarm64/00-complete-marker exists from a historical failed extraction; no executable.
cases.injection: Whole script, not extracted function.
cases.required_observation: Nonzero original refusal before profile/set_kill/FEX/runtime writes; no installed-success text; no acquisition; old partial bytes/inodes retained.
cases.boundary: Old selected-function failure/retry evidence is preserved and not rerun as the repaired result.

cases.seed: Client directory and package/steam_client_linuxarm64.installed marker exist; required companion absent.
cases.injection: Whole script; vary executable absent/present.
cases.required_observation: Neither the marker nor executable alone permits success. Refuse before writes and keep metadata unchanged.
cases.boundary: The marker contents are synthetic; not an invented Valve manifest grammar.

cases.seed: Client missing/partial, with each of the five literal-backslash siblings and unrelated root entries pre-existing.
cases.injection: Whole script.
cases.required_observation: Nonmutating ambiguity refusal; no migration, unlink, rename, normalization or recursive cleanup of old siblings.
cases.boundary: Five mappings apply only to newly owned stage bytes.

cases.seed: Fresh client, retained unrelated storage.
cases.injection: Recording transport writes a bounded partial archive then returns original 23. Separate deliberate retry supplies good bytes under a fresh attempt receipt.
cases.required_observation: First original nonzero preserved; no final client/installed receipt. Cleanup only proven stage ownership. Retry succeeds deterministically with good input; first failure is never overwritten by retry PASS.
cases.boundary: Retain manifest/transport/hash/decode/caller exits independently; never retry automatically inside fixture.

cases.seed: Fresh client.
cases.injection: Synthetic transport child and its descendant exceed deadline inside allocated private namespaces; record PIDs/start identities.
cases.required_observation: Finite whole-process-group termination/reaping plus outer containment; original timeout and any intervention recorded; no publication. No descendants before another allocation.
cases.boundary: Cannot replace original timeout with successful wrapper cleanup.

cases.seed: Fresh client with a valid-looking archive whose full digest disagrees with selected manifest.
cases.injection: Recording transport succeeds.
cases.required_observation: Full-hash rejection before decoder opens payload; no published client or metadata; unrelated state preserved.
cases.boundary: Global hash mismatch must not be claimed as CRC coverage.

cases.seed: Fresh client.
cases.injection: Corrupt a later member CRC at local +14 and central +16, leaving earlier valid entries; bind selected manifest SHA256 to the intentionally corrupt ZIP so full-file hash passes. Retry uses a newly bound good ZIP.
cases.required_observation: Original CRC/decode and full-caller failures retained; earlier output remains stage-owned only; no misleading installed state. Separate retry completes without accepting partial directory.
cases.boundary: Reuse corrected 71e CRC-offset source intent; do not edit old receipts or old generator.

cases.seed: Fresh client.
cases.injection: Independently choose missing required member, invalid ELF/program-header range, missing regular link target, or unexpected canonical root; one defect per case.
cases.required_observation: Reject before activation; original validation reason preserved; complete unrelated manifests unchanged. Each variant independently allocated.
cases.boundary: Required-member and ELF acceptance contracts need a selected implementation before executable fixtures.

cases.seed: Fresh client.
cases.injection: Independent duplicate/case collision, traversal, unreviewed backslash, local/central mismatch, unsupported type, overlapping local data and link-outside-tree variants.
cases.required_observation: Each rejects before final tree or metadata publication; no symlink traversal or writes outside owned stage.
cases.boundary: Do not combine variants into one failure then claim every check executed.

cases.seed: Fresh client with known free-space/hard-quota fixture.
cases.injection: Independently declared aggregate/member/entry overrun, actual expansion overrun, stage-write ENOSPC, and report/log cap.
cases.required_observation: Bounded original failure, no published partial client, owned cleanup or explicit held state. Exact reclaimed/retained observations and cleanup exit preserved.
cases.boundary: No cap reduction in product solely to pass test; controlled limits/injection require exact reviewed fixture binding.

cases.seed: Fresh client with different existing beta, conflicting .steam/steam or sdkarm64, preserved SDK/custom data.
cases.injection: Recording profile writes its sentinel if reached.
cases.required_observation: Under full-before-write policy: refuse before profile sentinel and all other writes. Under post-profile policy: narrower claim must be explicit, never report before-all-writes.
cases.boundary: Input selection for profile-provided STEAM_DOT must be decided first.

cases.seed: Fresh stage validated; absent eligible metadata nodes.
cases.injection: Fail one exact parent-local metadata operation using an admitted read-only/ENOSPC boundary, after receipt records before/created identity.
cases.required_observation: Original failure preserved; only candidate-created matching nodes reverted; client absent; unrelated .steam/package/SDK entries unchanged; explicit later retry.
cases.boundary: Do not rely on chmod to induce EACCES while running as root; phase/operation binding awaits implementation.

cases.seed: Fresh validated stage and prepared metadata.
cases.injection: A separate synthetic actor creates a destination sentinel immediately before no-replace publication.
cases.required_observation: Original publication refusal; concurrent destination survives unchanged; only provably owned metadata/stage may retire; no overwrite/whole-root replacement.
cases.boundary: Actor/timing uses a recorded implementation phase, not a sleep guess.

cases.seed: Fresh stage after validation and journaled metadata preparation.
cases.injection: Kill only recorded installer group at exact durable phase; preserve original signal receipt, then separately invoke full-script recovery.
cases.required_observation: No accepted partial client; recovery validates root/node identities and cleans or completes only its own transaction; original failure remains separate.
cases.boundary: Signal interruption is not power-loss evidence.

cases.seed: Client directory published, commit receipt not finalized.
cases.injection: Recorded phase interruption, then explicit full-caller recovery.
cases.required_observation: Recovery precedes any existing-client skip; verify complete tree plus metadata and journal identities, then complete or refuse safely. Directory existence is insufficient.
cases.boundary: Precise journal schema/phase names are pending; no injection hook invented yet.

cases.seed: Known interrupted transaction.
cases.injection: Replace one stage/metadata inode or parent/root alias with another actor's sentinel before explicit retry.
cases.required_observation: Recovery refuses cleanup; changed sentinel and unknown state remain untouched; original failure and held paths reported.
cases.boundary: Ownership is exact identity plus validated journal, not a directory naming convention.

cases.seed: Unknown pre-existing .steam-client-update-style directory/receipt with custom data.
cases.injection: Whole script.
cases.required_observation: Refuse ownership ambiguity; zero broad removal and no success from marker. Keep complete before/after byte/type/inode/link manifests.
cases.boundary: The final stage name is not assigned until implementation; this case adapts to its bound name.

cases.seed: Independent synthetic client/updater or installer lock, with required visibility.
cases.injection: Read-only admission before candidate write.
cases.required_observation: Refuse active/conflicting/unknown visibility without stopping another process; no writes. Lock serializes installer only; no claim it excludes all Steam updater races.
cases.boundary: Actual native quiescence and permissions remain installed-image qualifications.

cases.seed: Profile sets alternate STEAM_DOT and writes a sentinel; separate environment-override control.
cases.injection: Whole script from its real entrypoint.
cases.required_observation: Freeze policy: environment override preserved; profile override rejected by explicit contract. Preserve-profile policy: actual selected path used, with profile effects honestly accounted.
cases.boundary: This is a source compatibility choice, not just test plumbing.
